notablePrerequisites:
Builder's Talent is at least level 2.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token and a Food token.
When the Food token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 2.
